name: sherpa
description: Develop like a sherpa: composable /frame, /shape, and /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /analyze, /triage, /restory, and /invoke skills for analyzing, triaging, reconstructing story context, and running pack skills, with bundled codebase-explorer/review/build subagents and adversarial pressure at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; sherpa offers the tools. Nothing runs unasked, nothing lands in the repo unless you call /persist, and the opt-in inventory loop keeps its state outside it. Project-agnostic; extend with project packs.
